description: Transforms a SysML XMI model into a JSON model (XMI format) conforming to Json.ecore. Exogenous, out-place, horizontal transformation using Epsilon ETL rules. Each SysML element (PartDefinition, AttributeUsage, etc.) is mapped to a JSON Object with typed Members.

model.description: Source model filename in the repository (e.g., VehicleDefinitions.xmi)

metamodel.description: Source metamodel name (e.g., SysML, Family). Provides context for validation.

output.description: Output filename. If omitted, a name is auto-generated based on the input.
A JSON model in XMI format conforming to Json.ecore.
